name: Voltage or current balance relay
summary: Compares related measured circuits or quantities to detect an abnormal imbalance.
description: Compares related measured circuits or quantities to detect an abnormal imbalance.

In a drafting package, connect this reference to the compared voltage or current circuits. The associated drawing should trace the balance alarm and any blocked protection functions; the number identifies the role and does not specify the terminal arrangement, ratings or operating settings.
readingNotes: Identify the compared voltage or current circuits.
Trace the balance alarm and any blocked protection functions.
drawingChecklist: Label the compared voltage or current circuits.
Cross-reference the balance alarm and any blocked protection functions.
Identify the device tag, manual revision and logic drawing that define this implementation.
distinction: A 60 label may denote loss-of-potential supervision in a modern relay; it is not universally a complete VT fuse-failure scheme.
